youtube-transcript.description: YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract a clean transcript, captions or subtitles directly from any YouTube URL or video ID. Fast low-cost YouTube transcription for RAG, research, summarization, automation, video-to-text and caption workflows, with optional timestamped segments and language selection.

url.description: YouTube video URL for transcript, captions, subtitles or video-to-text extraction. Supports watch, youtu.be, Shorts, Live and embed URLs. Provide either url or videoId.

videoId.description: 11-character YouTube video ID to transcribe. Provide either videoId or url.

language.description: Optional preferred YouTube caption/transcript language code such as en, pt, es or fr.

includeSegments.description: When true, include timestamped YouTube transcript/caption segments in addition to the full transcript.

language.description: Language code of the selected YouTube caption/transcript track.

autoGenerated.description: Whether the selected YouTube captions were automatically generated.

wordCount.description: Number of words in the transcript.

characterCount.description: Number of characters in the transcript.

segments.description: Timestamped YouTube transcript/caption segments when includeSegments is true.
